An ESP32 FluidNC controller box for a small CNC router

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

26FRES-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    VINGND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    VINController VIN · C1 1 · Buffer U1 VCC · C2 1 · Buffer U2 VCC
    GNDController GND.2 · C1 2 · Buffer U1 GND · Buffer U1 2OE · Buffer U1 1OE · Buffer U1 4OE · Buffer U1 3OE · C2 2 · Buffer U2 GND · Buffer U2 2OE · Buffer U2 1OE · Buffer U2 4OE · Buffer U2 3OE
    X_STEPController D4 · Buffer U1 1A
    X_DIRController RX2 · Buffer U1 2A
    Y_STEPController TX2 · Buffer U1 3A
    Y_DIRController D18 · Buffer U1 4A
    Z_STEPController D19 · Buffer U2 1A
    Z_DIRController D21 · Buffer U2 2A
    SPINDLE_ENController D22 · Buffer U2 3A
    SPINDLE_PWMController D23 · Buffer U2 4A
    GNDController GND · Drivers 9 · Drivers 10 · Spindle 2 · Inputs 7 · Inputs 8
    X_STEP_5VBuffer U1 1Y · Drivers 2
    X_DIR_5VBuffer U1 2Y · Drivers 3
    Y_STEP_5VBuffer U1 3Y · Drivers 4
    Y_DIR_5VBuffer U1 4Y · Drivers 5
    Z_STEP_5VBuffer U2 1Y · Drivers 6
    Z_DIR_5VBuffer U2 2Y · Drivers 7
    SPINDLE_PWM_5VBuffer U2 4Y · Spindle 3
    SPINDLE_EN_5VBuffer U2 3Y · Spindle 4
    X_LIMITController D13 · Inputs 2
    Y_LIMITController D27 · Inputs 3
    Z_LIMITController D26 · Inputs 4
    PROBEController D14 · Inputs 5
    ESTOP_SENSEController D25 · Inputs 6
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
27FRES-WIRE-1

Fres is built

Fres is the controller box of a small three-axis CNC router: an ESP32 running FluidNC, two buffer chips that turn its 3.3 V step and direction signals into clean 5 V ones for external stepper drivers, and screw terminals for the drivers, limit switches, touch probe, spindle speed and an e-stop contact. You run the machine from a browser over Wi-Fi. The frame, motors, drivers, power supplies, spindle and the e-stop circuit itself are the machine's side and are not in this box.
